title: 7 Years Ago, A Cartoon Network/Sonic Crossover Erupted on The Screen
content: Sonic the Hedgehog isn’t a stranger to Cartoon Network , as one of the biggest animated representations of the Sega mascot had a series of his own on the cable network. Sonic Boom is one of the most beloved cartoons in the hedgehog’s history, first premiering on Cartoon Network in 2014.
author: ComicBook

title: Sakamoto Days Manga Tops 18 Million Copies in Circulation Worldwide
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account of Yuuto Suzuki 's Sakamoto Days manga announced on Tuesday that the manga has exceeded 18 million copies in circulation worldwide. Shueisha also published the manga's 28th compiled book volume on Tuesday. The manga announced in July that it is heading to its climax.
author: ANN

title: 5 Animation Studios That Never Made a Bad Anime
content: Over the decades, the anime industry has grown significantly thanks to its global popularity. While some of the oldest animation studios such as Toei Animation and Tatsunoko Production are active to this day , the industry expanded significantly with each new studio.
author: ComicBook

title: Reirin Dances as Shu Keigetsu in Though I Am an Inept Villainess Episode 5 Visual
content: Though I Am an Inept Villainess anime revealed a new visual featuring Reirin dancing in Shu Keigetsu’s body ahead of Episode 5. Studio Doga Kobo ( OSHI NO KO ) is in charge of the animation, with the anime first announced in March.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kemono Jihen Manga to End in 26th Volume After 10 Years
content: The 25th volume of Shō Aimoto 's Kemono Jihen manga announced on Tuesday that the series will end in the next volume. Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga in English and describes the story: Inugami is a Tokyo detective who specializes in the occult.
author: ANN

title: My Hero Academia Confirms Bakugo’s Final Pro Hero Ranking After Anime Finale Timeskip
content: My Hero Academia ‘s anime has officially come to an end with one final release exploring more of the time skip future, and with it has revealed Katsuki Bakugo’s final ranking in the top pro hero charts.

title: With No Season 2 Hopes, Major Shonen Jump Series Confirms It Will End After 10 Years
content: A major shonen series in Shueisha’s Jump magazines has confirmed it will end after ten long years, and there are still no hopes of its anime coming back for a Season 2 any time soon. Shonen Jump has had quite the year as there have been a umber of major series ending their runs after long stints with the magazine.
author: ComicBook

title: Your Letter Webtoon Gets Stage Musical Adaptation
content: A stage musical adaptation of the webtoon Your Letter will premiere at Plus Theater in Seoul, running from September 16 to November 29. Soo-ah Kim is writing the the production, with Sang-ah Pyo serving as adaptor and director. Hye-joo Jeon, A-jin Lee, and Dan-i Kim have been cast in the lead role of Sori Lee.
author: ANN
